newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Charts show further gains on Russian utilities-MC.
newsitem.headline: Charts show further gains on Russian utilities-MC.

text.p: Russian utility stocks are advancing strongly and could make further gains in the next few months according to technical analysis, London-based investment bank MC Securities said.
UES, Mosenergo and Lenenergo are technically the strongest, according to the report by analyst Julie Quist, dated January 30.
Mosenergo is racing higher and could reach resistance of $2 in the next few months, it said.
Lenenergo hit a new high and could move to $0.80 before reaching resistance, the report said.
Irkutskenergo could hit resistance of $0.30 in the near future, but it needs to consolidate recent gains to sustain the upward trend, it said.
At 1245 GMT on Monday Lenenergo was trading at $0.685. Mosenergo was trading at $1.489.
UES was trading at $0.2165, which was above the resistance of $0.20 per share seen in the report.
